w10_P4_002335: A 172,000 g pallet on a warehouse lift is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the larger root of x² - 9x + 18 = 0. The hoisting force needed for this is converted to kN. There are 7 lifts per building and 11 buildings, so the site figure is the per-lift value multiplied by 7 and then by 11. A 3 kN allowance is then added. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002336: A 44,000 g cart creeps along a lab rail at a speed in m/s equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 0x between x = 0 and x = 1. The logger takes the cart's energy of motion and subtracts a 23 J budget, recording a negative balance when the cart is under budget. Three carts run, so the group balance is 3 times that. The rail is 6 m long. A 17 J allowance is added to the group balance, and the result is multiplied by 5 for the 5 sessions. What is the final balance, in J?
w10_P4_002342: The total in a depot report, in kJ, is 12 times a line figure. The line figure is the combined energy of motion of 5 identical parcels, converted to kJ. Each parcel has a mass of 9 kg and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the greatest common divisor of 339 and 65. The conveyor belt is 14 m long. What is the total in the report, in kJ?
w10_P4_002345: A 15 kg tool head on a lathe carriage is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the slope of the curve y = 2x³ - 1·x² at the point x = 1. The drive supplies the force needed for this, less 18 N contributed by a spring, and the result is converted to kN. The carriage travel is 90 cm. The machine log records a net force by subtracting a 14 kN clamping load, with the drive direction positive, so it may be negative, and then multiplies by 6 for the 6 carriages in the cell. What net force does the log record, in kN?
w10_P4_002351: A 21 kg projectile on a test range flies at a speed in m/s equal to 6 times the sum of 7 and 4. Its energy of motion plus 30 J of launcher offset is the per-shot figure. Nine shots make a volley, 3 volleys make a session, and 11 sessions are run. The campaign total is therefore the per-shot value multiplied by 9, then by 3, then by 11. What is the campaign total, in J?
w10_P4_002353: A 40,000 g cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the greatest common divisor of 369 and 51. Eight such carts run together, so the combined energy of motion is 8 times that of one cart, and the combined value is converted to kJ. A 26 kJ battery reserve is added. Ten such groups operate, so the total is 10 times the group figure. What is the total, in kJ?
w10_P4_002363: A rocket-sled track is being commissioned. A 146,000 g sled is accelerated at a rate in m/s² found by taking the greatest common divisor of 289 and 54, multiplying it by 6, and then multiplying by 9. The booster must supply the thrust needed for this. The thrust is recorded in kN. What thrust is recorded, in kN?
w10_P4_002383: The final figure in a drone-hangar report, in kN, is a combined thrust expressed in kN minus a 20 kN tie-down load, with the thrust direction positive, so it may be negative. The combined thrust is that of 12 hangars each holding 12 drones, so it is the single-drone thrust multiplied by 12 and then by 12. A single drone supplies the thrust needed to accelerate its 6,000 g body at a rate in m/s² equal to the greatest common divisor of 299 and 267. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002388: A 93 kg sled on a test track is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the sum of the whole numbers from 1 to 11. The booster supplies the thrust needed for this, less 14 N contributed by a tailwind, and the result is converted to kN. The track is 500 m long. Six sleds run together, so the combined figure is 6 times that, and 16 kN of margin is then added. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002391: The final figure in a kart-club energy report, in kJ, is 1 kJ less than an adjusted figure. The adjusted figure is 12 kJ less than a fleet total expressed in kJ. The fleet total is the combined energy of motion of 12 identical karts. Each kart has a mass of 50,000 g and moves at a speed in m/s equal to 3 times the sum of 3 and 13. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_002392: The final figure in a press-hall report, in N, is 13 N less than a hall total. The hall total is 9 times a line figure. The line figure is 28 N of margin added to the combined force of 6 identical presses. Each press supplies the force needed to accelerate a 140 kg die at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 2x² + 1·x between x = 2 and x = 3. The press hall is 60 m long. What is the final figure, in N?
w10_P4_002412: The figure at the end of a bike-team report is in kJ and is obtained by converting a team total from J to kJ. The team total is the combined energy of motion of 6 identical riders. Each rider and bike together have a mass of 55 kg and move at a speed in m/s equal to 6 times the greatest common divisor of 141 and 42. The course is 40 km long. What figure ends the report, in kJ?
w10_P4_002414: A 44,000 g robot chassis is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the greatest common divisor of 217 and 326. Eleven such robots are driven together, so the combined drive force is 11 times that of one, and the combined value is converted to kN. There are 6 cells, so the floor figure is 6 times the cell value. A 19 kN structural allowance is then added. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002417: The final figure on a hoist sheet, in kN, is 29 kN of counterweight assist subtracted from a subtotal. The subtotal is 23 kN of structural allowance added to a hoisting force expressed in kN. The hoisting force is what is needed to accelerate a 139 kg load at a rate in m/s² equal to 11 times the larger root of x² - 6x + 5 = 0. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002419: A 109,000 g beam is accelerated by a jack at a rate in m/s² equal to the second derivative of y = 1·x³ - 4x² evaluated at x = 3. The jacking force needed for this is converted to kN, and 20 kN of dead-load allowance is added. The beam is 8 m long. Ten jacks operate, so the combined figure is 10 times that, and 23 kN of counterweight assist is then subtracted. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002428: The total in a sled-fleet energy report, in kJ, is 9 times a per-sled figure. The per-sled figure is obtained by taking the energy of motion of a sled, expressed in kJ, and adding 22 kJ of reserve and then a further 22 kJ of margin. The sled has a mass of 51,000 g and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 11. What is the total in the report, in kJ?
w10_P4_002429: An 81,000 g sled is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 3x² + 0x between x = 1 and x = 4. The booster supplies the thrust needed for this plus 16 N of rail friction. The track is 900 m long. There are 9 sleds per session and 4 sessions, so the campaign total is the per-sled value multiplied by 9 and then by 4. From the campaign total, 3 N of sensor bias is subtracted. What is the final figure, in N?
w10_P4_002431: The figure at the end of a cart-fleet energy sheet, in kJ, is 4 times a per-cart balance. The per-cart balance is the energy of motion of a 23 kg cart, expressed in kJ, minus a 15 kJ energy budget, recorded as negative when the cart is under budget. The cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the larger root of x² - 12x + 32 = 0. The cart track is 35 m long. What figure ends the sheet, in kJ?
w10_P4_002435: A 3 kg parcel on a sorting conveyor moves at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 1·x³ + 0x² at the point x = 1. Its energy of motion is converted to kJ. Twelve parcels ride each belt and there are 3 belts, so the depot value is the per-parcel value multiplied by 12 and then by 3. The belt is 25 m long. The depot records that value minus a 17 kJ energy budget, negative when under budget. What does the depot record, in kJ?
w10_P4_002436: The final line of a press-test sheet is a net force in kN, found by adding a 15 kN hydraulic assist to an earlier net figure, with the pressing direction positive, so it may be negative. That earlier figure was a drive force expressed in kN with a 28 kN return-spring load subtracted. The drive force is what is needed to accelerate a 155,000 g die at a rate in m/s² equal to the sum of 2k - 1 for k from 1 to 4. What is on the final line, in kN?
w10_P4_002438: An 89,000 g sled is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 13. Eight boosters each supply the thrust needed for this, and the range sums the 8 outputs and converts the sum to kN. The track is 1.1 km long. From that value, 8 kN of rail-brake load is subtracted, and then 25 kN of margin is added. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002439: A 110,000 g crate sits on a factory conveyor. Its acceleration in m/s² is found by taking the number of ways to choose 3 items from a set of 6, adding 28, subtracting 19, and then subtracting 25. The conveyor belt is 22 m long. What force must the drive supply to give the crate this acceleration, in N?
w10_P4_002447: A 75 kg sled on a test track is accelerated at a rate in m/s² found by taking 7 times the sum of 7 and 2, subtracting 20, and then subtracting 2. The booster must supply the thrust needed for this. The track is 450 m long. Five sleds run together, so the combined thrust is 5 times the single-sled value, and the combined thrust is converted to kN. What is the combined thrust, in kN?
w10_P4_002455: A 127,000 g die on a press is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the smaller root of x² - 6x + 8 = 0. Twelve identical rams each supply the force needed for this, and the press sums the 12 outputs and converts the sum to kN. The press log records a net force by adding a 7 kN hydraulic assist and then subtracting a 23 kN return-spring load, with the pressing direction positive, so it may be negative. What net force does the log record, in kN?
w10_P4_002457: A 99 kg crate on a warehouse conveyor is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the smaller root of x² - 5x + 4 = 0. The drive supplies the force needed for this, less 6 N contributed by a slight incline. The conveyor belt is 16 m long. Eleven conveyors run per floor, so the floor figure is 11 times the per-conveyor value, plus 5 N of margin. Three floors operate, so the site total is 3 times the floor figure. What is the site total, in N?
